history.summary: A well-located D03 leasehold 1BR (Wing Tai/Toll, 2017) at $1,890 PSF — a genuine ~6% discount to the $2,014 URA median on a deep 90-transaction series. Good Alexandra/RCR address near the Greater Southern Waterfront, but a weak 1.2%/yr appreciation rate keeps it Neutral rather than a buy.
history.rating_rationale: Listed at $1,890 PSF vs $2,014.5 URA median = -6%, supported by a strong 90-txn count — priced below recent deals. Score 612 is solid. The drag is appreciation: URA resale-only is only 1.20%/yr, well below the RCR ~5.8% baseline, suggesting the project has lagged. D03/GSW and One-North proximity give a rental floor, but a $1.2M 1BR is a niche, shallow-pool unit type for a 5-7yr investment.

history.summary: Below-market 1BR in a Toyo Ito-designed quality development in D03 (RCR), 10 min from Redhill MRT. Verified comps confirm the asking PSF is below recent resale levels, and the unit is unusually large for a 1BR (635 sqft), aiding livability and exit.
history.rating_rationale: Asking 1,889.76 PSF vs verified 6-month avg ~1,992.76 and 12-month avg ~1,988 — the ask is ~5% below trailing comps, supporting the large -18.4% age-adj and -4.2% vs-cohort discount (cohort 11, reasonable depth). Built 2017 by Wing Tai, Pritzker-laureate Toyo Ito architecture with strong ventilation/large units — a quality asset, not a cookie-cutter project. D03 is RCR (realized forward ~+3.5%, second-best region; this is NOT the inverted-CCR trap). The 635 sqft 1BR is roomier than typical investor units, improving own-stay/resale optionality. Confidence medium: the -18.4% is partly age-pooling against newer launches and the catalyst (Redhill is a 10-min walk, not at-door) is not decisive.
red_flags: Redhill MRT is ~10 min walk, not at-door — connectivity is good, not exceptional
-18.4% age-adj partly reflects pooling vs newer launches; true discount vs same-vintage comps is closer to ~5%
Flat trailing appreciation (1.2% CAGR) signals no recent price momentum
catalysts: Toyo Ito / Wing Tai quality build — design and large-unit premium
Verified ~5% discount to recent resale comps
